At their level, most people have families.
Cousins, large and small, plus dependent smaller families and teams, form a powerful network.

Chai Miaoyu had already returned to the villa, wearing her wedding dress and silver peep-toe high heels, as she responded to the thrusts of the man behind her, each one more intense than the last, seemingly poised to explode at any moment.
She heard her phone ring, saw the name, and hushed to the man behind her, "Ah...husband...it's a big client...be quiet...let me ask what it is..."
"Hello, Mr.
Tang, what's going on?" Chai Miaoyu regained her cool demeanor.
If it weren't for Zhao An rubbing against her hips from behind, one would have mistaken her for a hardworking, mature lawyer.
The thought of how this would affect his year-end evaluation gave Tang Bing a headache.
He had to find a solution.
Otherwise, who could stand being caught out for no reason?
Elsewhere, Tang Wenxiu had gotten some sleep and felt much better upon waking.
At least the nightmare-like feeling had subsided considerably.
She picked up the phone and checked the time: it was already three in the afternoon.
Business isn't that simple.
High-end processing relies on efficiency.
Every order requires a contract, payment, and delivery within the stipulated timeframe.
If you can't deliver, sorry, you're done for.
Pay the penalty.
Zhao An hadn't appeared in this incident from beginning to end.
Although he wanted to suspect someone, there was no clue or reason to point to him.
There was no reason to cause trouble for him, and no way to do it.
"Lawyer Chai, do you know any rubber raw material processors?
I need to buy some existing rubber raw materials," Tang Wenxiu asked.
She could only pin her hopes on Chai Miaoyu, who was known for her city connections.
"Goodbye, Young Master Bing," Liao Rong said, standing up to see him off, unfazed by the other party's threats.
One needs to be bold in business.
The bolder the person, the more productive the land.
"Okay, thank you very much." Tang Wenxiu could only hang up the phone.
There was nothing she could do.
If it was a breach of contract, then so be it.
Finding a new supplier was the only way to turn things around.
"Are you using them to threaten me?" Tang Bing's eyes turned slightly hostile.
"I'm supplying the Zheng Group, and you're asking them to deliver the goods to me?
Are you kidding me?"
After dinner, Zhao An left the house feeling refreshed.
Both of the women at home were seduced, and they even took a rather unusual wedding photo: Zhao An, dressed in a suit, with his mother and Aunt Chai.
Then came the threesome, though no photos were taken.
Both the incidents involving Edison Chen and Lee Chung-rui teach perverts a lesson: Playful fun is fun, but don't take photos.
You'll be screwed and die without knowing how.
With just two weeks until delivery, the materials still couldn't be obtained.
The total penalty for breach of contract would be over 500 million yuan, a crushing blow to Tang Bing.
No one could understand why this had happened.
Even after factoring in the compensation owed by the material supplier, Tang Bing would still need to come up with at least 500 million yuan to cover the cost.
This was the consequence of breach of contract.
Tang Bing had already temporarily allocated funds to help Liu Ke, but ended up getting him into trouble as well.
What kind of thing was that?
Was it just bad luck?
"I don't know.
I'm just a businessman, Young Master Bing.
You know I've always done business in a fair and honest way.
Don't embarrass me," Liao Rong said calmly.
He was actually a distant relative of Liao Ruoxia, a relationship that was only remotely related.
He didn't really care, otherwise he wouldn't have watched Liao Ruoxia's father suffer in poverty with such indifference.
"Master Bing, it's not that I don't want to give it to you.
I've already signed a contract with the Zheng Group and am obligated to supply them.
So, I'm sorry, if you want me to change my mind, you can only negotiate with the Zheng Group.
The contract clearly states it in black and white.
I wouldn't dare to breach the contract, please forgive me." Liao Rong was the owner of a plastics factory specializing in rubber and other goods, dealing in wholesale raw materials.
The banquet was still being held at the Swan Hotel, a banquet that represented reconciliation.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 Don’t mess with me!
paragraphs: Inside the private room, besides Tang Bing, there was a mature woman with an intellectual beauty. She was wearing a dress, and her gentle demeanor tinged with a hint of a strong woman, a quality cultivated through long tenure in a powerful position.

Next to the mature woman was an acquaintance, Zhang Qiaorong, a voluptuous, beautiful, and incredibly powerful woman. She was here to act as a go-between. Upon seeing Zhao An, she nodded slightly. Since they were partners, proper courtesy was still expected.
"Xiaobing, you...!"

Cooperation was indeed a good option, but it also depended on who you were collaborating with. Partnering with a profit-seeking idiot like Tang Bing was simply courting disaster and bringing unhappiness upon yourself.
Tang Wenxiu also looked at her nephew in surprise. She really couldn't believe that Tang Bing, whom she had watched grow up, would do such a thing.

"2 billion a year in net profit—note, that's net profit, not revenue. It's the amount obtained after deducting costs—the net profit!" Tang Bing's breathing became heavy after hearing his aunt's analysis. Two billion a year, that's the guaranteed minimum. "That's right, Zhao An. Hand over the formula, and all you have to do is sit back and collect the money. I'll take care of the rest."

"This is for you to try, but I advise you not to smoke, lest you become addicted." Zhao An lit up the cigarette and took a puff. As he exhaled, the entire private room was filled with the aroma of traditional Chinese medicine.
Tang Bing's words made him sweat profusely. He looked at Zhao An with a hint of fear. He knew something so obscure? And he seemed to be saying something else, something he hadn't said yet!
Compared to other men and women who cared only about appearances, Zhang Qiaorong preferred profit. Only tangible profit was the key to maintaining her own happiness.
"Did you take any traditional Chinese medicine?" Tang Bing asked, somewhat surprised, confused as to what the other man was trying to do.

"Why? From what I understand, taxes in the tobacco industry are very heavy, but with cigarettes of this quality, if they were marketed, the net profit could be at least 2 billion a year. Mr. Zhao's plans are beyond my comprehension. Perhaps that's what makes you unique and special," Tang Wenxiu said calmly, viewing the situation from a third-party perspective.

Tang Bing stood up and clapped his hands, a hint of a smile on his face. "Zhao An, right? This is our first meeting, and there have been many misunderstandings. Come, take a seat. I'm honored that you've done me the honor of coming here. Don't say anything yet. Let me offer you a glass of baijiu. Two liang (approximately 200g). I'll drink it!" Tang Bing then picked up Erguotou and poured himself a glass—actually two liang. He drank it all in one gulp, his face flushed red.
This gesture made Tang Bing's eyes flicker. He also noticed Zhao An tossing a cigarette over, which he caught.

"You talk like the whole province belongs to you. You're so awesome, why don't you go to space? Shouldn't you get some people to vote for you, because you can take us to the moon?" Zhao An quipped bluntly. And he still supports cooperation? He's never seen such an arrogant Party A!
"You!" Tang Bing was a little annoyed. This guy was always antagonizing him. Didn't he know that cooperation was the best option?
"I'm here to apologize, Zhao An. Your methods and my resources, combined, will naturally make you a fortune. And I have connections you may not have. I can do things you can't."

Zhao An sat down, facing Tang Bing. He crossed his legs, took out a cigarette, and placed one hand on the back of the chair. "If you have something to say, say it now. I'm not familiar with you, and there's nothing to discuss. Don't touch my woman. Humph, cut the crap."

Zhao An was amused at the sight. Wasn't that just a mature woman he'd randomly picked after strengthening himself? His entire body was burning hot, and he was looking for a woman to vent his desires. Using infrared positioning, he immediately locked onto Tang Wenxiu, and so, Tang Wenxiu was in trouble. Zhao An knocked her unconscious, raped her, and then unceremoniously ejaculated inside her.
Zhao An took out a pack of cigarettes and threw it over. "I don't have any extra. Just come find me at my company later."
A flicker of irritation flashed in Tang Bing's eyes, but he didn't show it. He was indeed furious, annoyed by the other party's attitude, but what could he do? He couldn't do anything.

Zhao An raised his index finger and shook it. "You're not qualified yet, and there's nothing to discuss with you. People like you can't cooperate. I'd rather be an adversary than a partner. The woman who jumped from the building ten years ago was linked to you, right? I won't reveal the specific culprit. You were also the mastermind behind the violent takeover nine years ago, and I don't need to elaborate on that either. You're nothing but scum. Times have changed. Do you think your tactics still work? Do you need me to show you the evidence?"

"Hehe, this is a new type of cigarette. It truly eliminates the harmful effects of tobacco. It uses the purest medicinal herbs and is made using an exclusive secret recipe. Smoking is harmful to your health, so I choose to make my own cigarettes. Don't worry, I don't plan on selling them." Zhao An's smile was filled with immense pride. He had mastered the secret recipe, but he didn't want to sell it. What a strange person!

Tang Wenxiu felt a certain familiarity with Zhao An, but couldn't place it. She simply couldn't imagine a high school student raping her. After all, her daughter and son were much older than Zhao An, and she herself was already quite old. She hadn't yet realized how attractive a mature, elegant woman could be to men, nor had she realized her rapist was right before her eyes.

"Haha. You're as incomprehensible as ever, Zhao An. You look so cheerful." Zhang Qiaorong raised her glass and made a toast, her beautiful eyes gleaming with a hint of a smile. She wouldn't smile at anyone, even if she was calm. But Zhao An was different.

"Enough of that nonsense! Since you're unwilling to cooperate with me, what are you doing here? You're not cooperating, and you're here to make fun of me?" Tang Bing roared angrily. The feeling of being caught in a trap is truly unpleasant. It feels like a thorn in your side, like you could die at any moment.

"Idiot, what's wrong with me coming for dinner? Don't blame me for being so blunt. Don't mess with me, or your family won't be able to protect you." Zhao An's tone was tinged with murderous intent, making Tang Bing feel like he'd been plunging into an ice cellar.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 Tang Bing is scared!
paragraphs: Zhang Qiaorong's expression changed. She knew Tang Bing was a scumbag, but she hadn't realized just how much. It seemed she had underestimated a scumbag's resolve. With a nonchalant attitude, she lit a herbal cigarette, leaned back in her chair, her eyes narrowed, and she couldn't tell what she was thinking.

"I understand." Tang Bing sat down weakly. He was truly frightened. The other party hadn't attacked because they were hitting the snake's weakest point, completely ignoring his intention to survive. It was ridiculous that he had been thinking of trading blows with them, a few rounds of back-and-forth, only to have them resort to atomic bombs. With a trump card in hand, who could withstand that?

After Zhao An warned them, he shamelessly sat down and continued to eat and drink. With this evidence submitted, Tang Bing's fate would be dire. Execution wouldn't be excessive, but his family's influence had mitigated the impact. But Zhao An still had evidence. It was a ticking time bomb. If he was in a bad mood, he could kill him at any moment!
"Young Master An, I'll toast you. I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't have been rude to you. I'll drink three as punishment!"

Tang Bing's face paled slightly. He knew he had hit a wall this time. Wanting to fight to the death? He didn't have the guts. Anyone capable of obtaining evidence of his crimes was already too high a level for him to provoke.
Zhang Qiaorong also ate quickly, maintaining her composure. "No, Aunt Wenxiu, do you want to come with me to the auction on Monday?"

From beginning to end, he had no intention of stepping in, simply hiding behind the scenes, watching everything unfold coldly. This kind of meticulous enemy is the most difficult to deal with. Tang Wenxiu rubbed his head in annoyance. He'd settle the matter with Tang Bing when he got back, but before that, he had to deal with Zhao An. The information he possessed was so powerful, almost like a treasure trove, it made one doubt whether he was actually there. But even if he was there, Zhao An was only six or seven years old ten years ago. Who would care about a six or seven-year-old child?

"Is it difficult? If it's difficult, then don't do it. No one's forcing you. Do you know how that feels? Haha, superior people?" Zhao An scoffed. He despised those who thought they were so superior the most. As a commoner, he hated them the most and was the first to punish them.

Zhao An shook his head. "I won't cooperate with him. He's heartless and ungrateful. Don't mess with me. I won't interfere with other people's problems, as long as they don't mess with me. If they don't mess with me, he'll still be a dashing rich kid. If they mess with me, the law will naturally punish him. It has nothing to do with me."

"Three as punishment? Haha, drink these three bottles, then get out of here and settle the bill." Zhao An placed three bottles of baijiu in front of the man. A bottle of baijiu weighs at least two kilograms. Three bottles at once weighs six kilograms. Who could handle that? This is baijiu! A baijiu over 40% alcohol—a normal person wouldn't even be able to drink a kilogram.

Tang Wenxiu felt the atmosphere was a bit awkward, so she stood up, walked over, poured Zhao An a glass of wine, and extended her hand with a smile. "Hello, I'm Tang Wenxiu, the Purchasing Director of the Tang Group, and Xiaobing's aunt. Nice to meet you, Mr. Zhao."
He didn't eagerly inquire about the other party's family background. Since he wasn't prepared to disclose it, there was no need to ask. Leaving a good impression was essential for future cooperation.
Zhao An extended his hand and shook it casually. "Just for your honor. I've heard that the buyers you choose are always clean and have excellent cost control."

"Generally speaking, I wouldn't be in the tobacco business. I don't advocate smoking, and I don't want to get involved in that industry. I don't value the small profits. Instead of dealing in tobacco, I'd rather do something meaningful. Okay, I'm done. Do you have anything you want to discuss? I'm in a good mood, and I'll give you a chance." Zhao An's eating manners were unsightly, but they only referred to eating, not making money.

Tang Wenxiu beamed at the compliment, completely unaware that it was the beast before her who had defiled her yesterday. "You're so kind! Young Master Zhao is truly remarkable. You've built a respected internet company from scratch. Your earning power is now a hot topic."

Tang Wenxiu's eyes changed slightly when he saw the three bottles of baijiu. "Young Master Zhao, Young Master An, drinking these three bottles will cause trouble, right?" The implication was that he shouldn't overdo things.

If Tang Wenxiu knew she had been violated by the beast before her, she certainly wouldn't have smiled. She'd probably have slapped him in the face. Sometimes ignorance is bliss; it's because of ignorance that one can live well.

Tang Wenxiu shook her head and said with a smile, "No, I looked at the prices, and they're not acceptable to me. Xiaobing is responsible for this matter. Mr. Zhao, whatever mistakes Xiaobing made are in the past. I offer you a toast. Please be merciful. I will discipline and control him properly." He then picked up a two-liang glass of baijiu and downed it, his face flushing from the choking.

"You can go to the hospital right after drinking and get your stomach pumped, but it'll be quite uncomfortable." Zhang Qiaorong suddenly offered a suggestion. It seemed like it was for Tang Bing's benefit, but in reality, it was just a matter of taking sides. She was urging him to be more sensible and just get a gastric pump. If Zhao An really got mad, it wouldn't be as simple as a gastric pump; he might die.

Zhang Qiaorong's eyes flickered. She expected many people to use against him. But he himself had no evidence to hold against him. At most, they could say he was morally corrupt, had a promiscuous private life, and had several girlfriends. But that was all. Isn't it normal for someone with money to have sex with women? With mutual consent, there are naturally plenty of women willing to sacrifice themselves for money. There's nothing wrong with that.

Tang Bing stopped his aunt's advice and picked up the bottle, saying, "Young Master An, I'm blind, but you're so magnanimous, you've treated me like a fart. I'm going to drink it now!" He then began to pick up the bottle, blowing into it, and downing the liquor like beer.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 Go get a gastric lavage!
paragraphs: Tang Bing guzzled baijiu, each mouthful like a knife scraping back and forth across his throat, the pain unbearable. His stomach burned. Drinking so much baijiu at once would have given him no chance of a perforation, let alone a gastric perforation. Even if he didn't suffer intestinal bleeding from the liquor, he'd likely suffer from alcohol poisoning. While death was unlikely, rushing to the hospital would still cause severe pain. It wasn't a pleasant experience.

Furthermore, he'd been the one to do this cruel thing. The other party hadn't even taken action, but had simply produced evidence to convince him to give in. It was truly humiliating. Tang Bing was already a bit tipsy, his stomach churning and burning as if it were on fire. "Young Master An... uh... Young Master An, are you satisfied?"

The Tang Group has many businesses, and I can see you're an ambitious man. We could collaborate in many areas, including transportation, factory manufacturing, and finance. What do you think?"
"Get lost!" Zhao An waved him off like trash, then said to the two women, "Eat, keep eating."

"You've made money, so whatever you say makes sense. Okay, I'm done eating. I still have to prepare for the auction, so that's all. We'll have tea together sometime next time. Goodbye. Zhao An, however, smiled nonchalantly and asked, "Zhang Qiaorong, aren't you and Li Qian inseparable? Why did you come to the appointment alone today? Could it be that Li Qian found a boyfriend and dumped you?"

Tang Wenxiu sat quietly, worried about her nephew's safety, yet afraid to leave without permission. She wasn't afraid of Zhao An, but rather wanted to reach a partnership. He was a genius, a business genius!

"After you finish drinking, I can consider a partnership. Haha, you can't even finish three bottles of baijiu, and you're still talking about business? And you're still calling yourself a man? It was no different from drinking plain water.

"I told you, I'm not interested in real estate. Believe it or not. I'll contact you when the opportunity arises. I don't have any such plans right now." Zhao An truly had no intention of entering the real estate market. He had more than enough money now. On the contrary, Tang Wenxiu was a bit tipsy. She knew she'd had a bit too much and might pass out if she drank any more.

In the private car, Zhao An spent the entire journey on his phone, interacting with the female streamers and chatting with his followers in the livestream room. His occasional chats would send his fans into a frenzy. After giving Feng Timo and the other female streamers two 500-yuan rockets, the car arrived at a residential complex.
A gust of cold wind sobered Tang Wenxiu, still hungover, somewhat. She still had a splitting headache, clutching her head. "Are we home yet? Young Master An, I might need you to take me home."

Raping Tang Wenxiu was his first time. It could be considered both rape and drugging. It was simply to satisfy his lust. And Tang Wenxiu was indeed very tight. Judging by the tightness, it must have been a long time since she'd had sex, at least three years. It was incredibly tight. It felt only slightly looser than my mother and Aunt Chai, almost like a virgin.
"Mr. An, you're joking. You're attracted to beautiful young women, not an old woman like me. Thank you, I'll be more than welcome. With your escort, the journey will be incredibly safe."
Those outsiders think they can outdo him, the original creator, with simple plagiarism? Don't dream. Dreams are full of possibilities. Why bother imagining such things?
"It was really fun chatting with Young Master An tonight. I'm a little tipsy and can't handle the alcohol. I'll be heading home now. Sorry."
Tang Wenxiu looked at Zhao An with some surprise and uncertainty, because a woman's sixth sense told her that something seemed off about him.

Zhao An stood up, intending to take advantage of the man's drunkenness to have sex. But on second thought, he decided to keep her in suspense. Getting laid was easy. He had no shortage of women, and keeping a mature woman in suspense, letting her, driven by lust and conflicting interests, actively seduce him—wouldn't that be wonderful?

"Haha, you're really good at talking. I'm an old woman, who would have such bad intentions?" Tang Wenxiu giggled, covering her mouth. She instantly recalled yesterday's knockout and rape. She felt a surge of shyness, her lower body throbbing. It had been ages since she'd experienced the feeling of love between a man and a woman.

"Do you have any ginger at home? Boil ginger and brown sugar, then add a little green tea leaves. That's the most authentic brown sugar ginger tea, perfect for sobering up." Zhao An said as he walked, still looking down at his phone. Multitasking wasn't difficult for him.

Lose money? Those platforms shouldn't lose money, or at least they'll break even. But they'll soon be mired in endless debt in two months. Signing contracts, recruiting celebrities, and so on all require spending money.

Haha, they'll soon learn what it means to eat something tasteless and then throw it away. Nothing is that simple. Not all plagiarism is effective." No one in purchasing has ever been poor. Which purchasing agent isn't incredibly wealthy?

Zhao An's smile was profound. Looking at the drunken beauty was truly charming. You know, mature women with temperament have always been his favorite. Young beauties rarely have unique temperaments. Zhang Qiaorong and Li Qian were both examples of this: one cool and powerful, the other seductive and alluring.
The complex was closed to outsiders, so the only way was on foot.
And the first time he raped her was probably with Liu Qianhong. That mature woman instilled in Zhao An a desire and urge to conquer her.

"Let's go, I'll take you home. Don't overthink it. I think you're beautiful, but I don't have a habit of forcing myself on women. I never force myself on women, except maybe once in a while. Okay, a few times, but not often anyway," Zhao An said calmly, speaking frankly and walking ahead so the woman couldn't see his expression.
"It's okay. I'm always helpful. You can put your arm around my shoulder. Which floor is that office building on?" Zhao An showed no impatience, and there were security guards watching.

Zhao An's platform earns a lot of money, but so does advertising, at least half of which goes to advertising. And after the advertising, he needs a star attraction. He's thankful for his participation in "The Voice of China," which boosted his fame and presence. Otherwise, the effectiveness of the livestream will be greatly diminished.

Tang Wenxiu dialed a series of numbers, then slowly walked forward, her arm around Zhao An's shoulder. The click of her high heels echoed in the silent hallway. The streetlights were ample, so there was no need to worry about thieves or anything like that. The security here was quite good. A single apartment would cost at least 10 million yuan, and Tang Wenxiu, a member of the Tang family and a member of the group's management, naturally wouldn't be short of money.

Tang Wenxiu secretly glanced at Zhao An's phone. Sure enough, he was looking at the young female anchor. Her head was still a little groggy. "I have both at home, but I can't do it. How did you come up with the idea of live streaming? You're truly a genius. Revenue almost exceeded a billion in one day. It's a miracle."

After the stage of lust, Zhao An now focused on toying with the mind. While ensuring his prey wasn't being targeted by other hunters, he could then develop it himself, waiting for it to be in prime condition before devouring it. That was the most satisfying way.

The initial outlay is enough to make the capitalists suffer. The payback is slow, but the money is already gone. How can they accept this without further investment to recoup their capital? This is a trap, tempting on the surface, but incredibly dangerous.
As for Qin Xue, it was more of an adultery, an exchange of interests. It could be considered a business deal, but they ended up becoming long-term sex partners, and she ended up getting pregnant.
Zhao An certainly won't say it himself. All words pale in comparison to his revenue reports. Since the capitalists are seeking their own doom, let these greedy businessmen enjoy it!

paragraphs: Arriving at the apartment, Tang Wenxiu slumped onto the sofa, seemingly drunk and about to fall asleep, one hand still in her handbag.

From a normal perspective, a drunken beauty would be a perfect opportunity for rape. Furthermore, Tang Wenxiu possessed an intellectual, elegant, and mature aura, making it difficult for any normal man to resist.

Tang Wenxiu sat up. Although still a little dizzy, she wasn't paralyzed. She stroked her hair, picked up the cup, blew on the ginger tea, and took a sip. The taste was sweet. She sighed, "Wait, was that you yesterday?"
Silence returned to the living room. Tang Wenxiu sat on the sofa, her eyes downcast, her mind etched in her mind. "This shameless fellow."

"I heard Xiaobing went to the hospital for gastric lavage?" A cold female voice came, tinged with seriousness. It sounded like a mature woman, but the boldness in her voice was something a younger woman wouldn't possess.

Tang Wenxiu's beautiful eyes narrowed slightly, appearing hungover, but a glint of wisdom shone through them. She wondered if Zhao An had raped her yesterday. Although they had met for the first time tonight, her intuition told her that there was something wrong with this man. So she used drunkenness to test the waters, unfazed by the threat of being forced upon her. The Tang family wasn't to be trifled with. They wanted to humiliate her? She wasn't the type to be molested without a word.

"No, I have no interest in him. He's no match for me. He's still alive, despite all the noise. I'm truly impressed that your Tang family could protect a worthless person for so long. I only came to you because I was impulsive and had something to do. I'm sorry, sorry." Zhao An apologized insincerely.

"Well, contact him. The evidence he has is very dangerous and must be dealt with quickly. Please take a closer look at Xiaobing. Thank you." The female voice was calm, as if she were considering something.
This process required precise timing; even knowing the recipe meant it couldn't be replicated. Much like the recipe for Coca-Cola, it's clear that most people can't make it, nor can they do it well.

"I don't think he's planning to do that. I'll find time to talk to him. He's quite capable in business. The branch's losses this year must be recouped. The late procurement is my fault." Tang Wenxiu wasn't targeting Zhao An, but spoke the truth.
Zhao An's unconventional tactics left her somewhat bewildered, and even doubted her own suspicions.

A woman who appeared hungover was actually as discerning as a mirror. Such women are difficult to conquer, but once conquered, they wouldn't betray a man for the sake of so-called family interests. Instead, they would wholeheartedly follow the man who conquered them. There were pros and cons; it all depended on the choice.
"Haha, I was just kidding. Okay, I'm leaving. Let's have tea together next time." Zhao An waved his hand and left, closing the door behind him.
The atmosphere grew awkward, and neither of them spoke. Tang Wenxiu sat on the sofa, while Zhao An stood at the door.

"Yes, he drank six kilograms of baijiu. He deserved it." Tang Wenxiu recounted all the evidence Zhao An had given her, without holding back. She was still a little overwhelmed by Zhao An's generous admission. She touched the cup and felt a business card beneath it. She pulled it out and saw it was a card with only a name and a phone number. The female voice on the other end remained silent. "Is he planning to take on the Tang family?"

Zhao An soon emerged with a bowl of genuine brown sugar ginger tea and placed the cup on the table. "Drink it yourself. Stay out of Tang Bing's affairs. I have no interest in working with that scumbag. If something goes wrong, I might be implicated. Also, take your hands out. It's better to learn some self-defense techniques than using a stun gun. My luxury club has that service; you can try it. No discount." With that, he left.
Tang Wenxiu's heartbeat quickened, her eyes filled with disbelief. "Why? Because I'm Tang Bing's aunt? You just want revenge on Tang Bing, right?"
Tang Wenxiu laughed in anger. How could such a shameless person exist in the world?
"How about another try?" Zhao An suggested.
When the rich aroma wafted into the air, he continued to scoop up some of the boiling water, filtered and rinsed the green tea leaves, and then tossed them in with the water to boil.
Zhao An paused. "It was me." His voice was calm, almost eerily so.
Soon the phone rang. Tang Wenxiu answered, languidly saying, "Um, what's up?"

Zhao An didn't bother to take advantage of the situation. Instead, he went to the kitchen, opened the refrigerator, and found brown sugar, ginger, and green tea. He expertly began his cooking demonstration, throwing the brown sugar in with the cold water.

Despite having no evidence that Zhao An had ever ejaculated inside her, she relied on her intuition. Just like when her husband had cheated on her ten years earlier, she knew it without needing proof. This intuition helped her rise through the family ranks and also made her distrust the idea of love. Men's words are deceitful.
"Are you serious or joking? Do you think it's possible?"

With swift movements, he peeled the ginger and quickly sliced it, creating incredibly thin slices, even thinner than a hair. After determining the boiler's temperature, he tossed the sliced ginger into the water and brought it to a boil.

But Zhao An knew full well that if he actually went ahead with it, he would definitely be caught. Tang Wenxiu, seemingly hungover, was actually holding a stun gun, a deadly device that could easily shock someone into submission.
In less than five seconds, Tang Wenxiu realized what was happening, her beautiful eyes gleaming with confusion. "What are you going to do?"

"Okay, I will. That's it for now." Tang Wenxiu hung up the phone. Looking at the number on the business card, she briefly considered throwing it away. But she kept it, entered the number into her phone, and burned it with a lighter, leaving no evidence.

Young and old, male and female, everyone found Zhao An appealing.
Na Ying, quite cleverly, stood beside Zhao An, a formal smile plastered on her face. "Congratulations, Mr. An."

The four mentors seated at the front were somewhat surprised. This level of affability had reached an extreme, arguably even greater than any of their own. This was pure superstardom! Wow, I'm just wowed!
A middle-aged man walked onto the stage and, with the help of a hostess, handed a glass trophy to Zhao An. "Congratulations!"
"Thank you, everyone. My song is over." Zhao An said, then slowly stepped back from the stage, leaving with a carefree demeanor, without a single thought of regret.
Na Ying was also speechless and gave him a perfect score of 10.

Huo Wenxi made a victory gesture from the audience, her face beaming with excitement. Only if Zhao An succeeded would she, as an agent, be taken seriously. Being an agent for a big star—or rather, bringing up a big star—was much more fulfilling.
"I think it's fine. Champion, well-deserved!" Liu Huan immediately gave him a perfect score of 10. Besides, Zhao An had previously praised him, and he naturally wanted to express his support.
No wonder so many people love being a celebrity. Being flattered and adored is truly wonderful. Watching these lickers was a real treat.

The lights flashed, and being watched by all those cameras and cameras, it felt really good to be on the headlines. Especially hearing the audience around me chanting my name, it felt a bit overwhelming. It was so refreshing.
All four mentors gave full marks. So, was there any need to announce the winner? It was practically predetermined the moment the result came out. That's it.
Unlike Na Ying's performance, Zhao An's voice carries a melancholy, capturing the emotional struggles of both men and women. Everyone can find a connection in the song, which is truly remarkable.

On the stage, the host had already invited the operations manager of the company hosting the competition to present Zhao An with his award.

Seeing the two men's resolute stance, Yang Kun reluctantly gave them a perfect score. And Harlem Yu, the "helper" who was there, was even worse. He was just there to make up the numbers. If he weren't with Liu Huan and Na Ying, who would even know him? Who was he?

"Now, please welcome the operations manager of the herbal tea company, the sponsor of this program, to present the award to our champion. This champion is truly well-deserved. I'll never forget that. I wonder if you all feel the same way? Okay, let's all welcome the presenter with applause!" The host's skills were quite good; at least his words were appropriate and didn't stifle the audience.

Yang Kun didn't die; he was still popular for a while, but this popularity wasn't what he wanted. Popularity was good, but it didn't bring any profit, so it was better not to have it!

They do have the strength, but the opponents they encountered were too strong. It wasn't because they were incompetent, but because they encountered a genius. It was not their fault.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: A Positive Personality!
paragraphs: Post-match interviews quickly began, with many reporters from well-known websites arriving to interview him. Looking at the dozen or so microphones before him, Zhao An's heartbeat quickened slightly. It was a bit too many. Was this what celebrity felt like?

Traditional artists face these kinds of face-to-face interviews, with photographers constantly snapping away. They have to deal with all sorts of unconventional questions and even tricky tactics—things rarely encountered online. After all, they're separated by a screen. If things don't work out, they can just take a break and come back after figuring out a plan.

After the applause, another reporter asked a question, but this time, no tricky questions, a more normal one. "Hello, have you ever thought about entering the entertainment industry? You're a great singer and have a great personality. Have you considered it?"
After the interview, Zhao An signed autographs for some enthusiastic fans and took photos with them, satisfying their fan-chasing urges.

When he finished speaking, someone applauded, and the applause soon continued. This statement truly stirred excitement and resonated with the truth. Foreign language skills are truly nothing to be proud of.

At this question, Zhao An smiled faintly and answered fluently in English, then again in Russian, then English, Korean, French, and German. He answered them all, his smile growing even brighter. "Knowledge is endless; how much you learn depends on the individual. Of course, you should read. Books hold the keys to wealth and beauty."

"I'm not sure. I'm still a student. If I have time to do other things besides studying, I'll consider it. So I'm not sure. I'll finish my studies first, and then I'll consider other things later." Zhao An replied with a smile. Entertainment industry? Sorry, I don't have any ideas yet. He's just an ordinary person, not interested in anything fancy.

"Are you proud of your foreign language proficiency?" Another tricky question, one not so easy to answer. If you don't answer it well, you could easily be accused of being pro-Western, which is a serious issue. It could easily lead to criticism and ultimately destroy your image. No one likes a celebrity who licks the boots. Fans can be licks, but licks don't like licks. That's a fact.

Zhao An laughed, a laugh that was somewhat arrogant. "A foreign language is just a tool; there's nothing to be proud of. Only when a foreign language serves as a bridge between your own people and a foreign-speaking country do you have value. And never leave your home country, no matter how good your foreign language skills are. There are countless foreigners working as beggars. Are their foreign language skills bad? Why should you expect to get a good job if you go there? Are you going to just get by? You won't make it, and you won't have any value. No matter how good your foreign language skills are, without skill, you won't be respected. The key to a person's value lies in whether or not you have real skills. Therefore, foreign languages are just tools; there's nothing to be proud of. There's no point in worshipping foreign languages. No matter how accurate or perfect your pronunciation is, it's useless; just being useful is enough. Okay, next question."

The interview ended quickly. Zhao An handled every question with ease, not needing Huo Wenxi's help at all. His effortless expression, a perpetually smug smile, made everyone feel good. Approachability is a fascinating thing. It's not perfect, but at least it's very useful when dealing with fans.
This pretentious display of power was unexpected; no one could have imagined Zhao An's foreign language proficiency was so impressive.

"Hello, Zhao An, I'm a reporter from Fengyun Daily. You're a really good singer. You've surpassed the four mentors, haven't you?" a male reporter began. It was a tricky question. If Zhao An admitted it, he'd be stepping on Na Ying and Liu Huan to get to the top, which would seem arrogant and would ruin his popularity. After all, no one likes being friends with someone who steps on their shoulders to get to the top.

All eyes suddenly turned to the reporter who had asked the question, making him blush. Was a grown man being looked at so shyly? Not everyone could ignore the bright lights and cameras. The adrenaline rush could easily cause blood pressure to spike.
"Let's go get something to eat. I might have a livestream tonight, and I have an English competition tomorrow, so I'm a bit busy," Zhao An said to his agent.

Huo Wenxi nodded, watching from the sidelines. Her cheerful and cheerful demeanor didn't sound like a newcomer at all, but rather like a seasoned veteran who had been in the entertainment industry for years.

Zhao An's eyelids twitched. As a seasoned sly sly man, he immediately saw through the man's intentions. He still wanted to play a trick on him? Zhao An smiled faintly, a triumphant smile on his lips. "Your question is quite tricky. Hey, you're the last one to get some rest, aren't you? Those dark circles under your eyes—you're not one of those hardworking employees who pulls all-nighters, are you? Everyone, please give him a close-up. This is what extreme dedication looks like. It's not easy. Amazing!" He then began to applaud, his smile growing even brighter.

Huo Wenxi's beautiful eyes sparkled. Even though Zhao An was a jerk, she still assisted him wholeheartedly. So far, it seemed to be working well. At least he was a sensible person when it came to the big issues.

Upon hearing this question, Huo Wenxi couldn't help but walk over and stand behind Zhao An, ready to intervene if her boss seemed at a loss. This is what a professional agent must do. Not every agent wants to be like Song Zhe, constantly dreaming of sleeping with other people's wives. So, to avoid being cheated on, it's better to have a female agent.

Zhao An's words were simple and concise, practically shattering the trap. Trying to trick him? Sorry, the tricks here are too simple. Only a cunning old man can deal with a cunning old man. Nothing else will work.
After finally finishing his work, it was already almost seven o'clock, and he was starving.
The second reporter began asking, "Zhao An, would you ever join the entertainment industry? You sing so well, can you keep up with your studies?"

"Okay, I've turned down a lot of commercial offers for you, but I do have a few directors who want you to try out for camera work. Are you interested?" Huo Wenxi was still quite busy, helping Zhao An manage these external relationships.
